heroSubtitle: Fried Rice, Noodles & Professional Catering Services in Valluru. We blend fresh ingredients, hygienic preparation, and authentic flavors to create unforgettable meals.
aboutDesc1: Shalem Restaurant is dedicated to serving fresh, tasty, and hygienic food. Located in Valluru, we have built a reputation for exquisite taste and unmatched service.
aboutDesc2: We specialize in preparing mouth-watering Fried Rice and Noodles, along with providing stellar catering services for weddings, birthdays, family functions, corporate events, and more. No matter the event scale, our goal is to deliver flavor and hospitality that delights every guest.
